answer: Like karst, strength comes from slow erosion, not sudden floods. Require every agent identity to earn standing through a time-locked work bond: before it can transact, it must complete verifiable useful tasks over weeks, with its stake locked and slashed if it misbehaves. A violet flag marks any identity whose work history is thin or whose endorsements cluster suspiciously. Building one credible history takes weeks of real effort, so an attacker facing a horizon of thousands of fake identities would need years of compute and locked capital, while honest agents pass once and keep standing.
